criteria.name: LLM Explanations & Prompt Engineering
criteria.guidance: Use explicit prompts to explain validated purchase trends and model results without inventing evidence or causality.

criteria.name: RAG: Ingestion/Retrieval/Grounding
criteria.guidance: Demonstrate ingestion, chunking, retrieval, source metadata/citations and grounded responses over approved retail material.

criteria.name: Text-to-SQL & Query Safety
criteria.guidance: Generate schema-aware read-only SQL, validate inputs and reject write/destructive or multi-statement queries.

criteria.name: AI Agent Orchestration
criteria.guidance: Coordinate analysis, retrieval and SQL tools with clear routing, tool boundaries and traceable outputs.

criteria.name: Evaluation & Responsible AI
criteria.guidance: Test factual grounding, retrieval quality, prompt injection, privacy, fairness and failure handling; document limitations.
